
                    ╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
                    ║  PCBoard 15.4 Revival — What's New   ║
                    ╚══════════════════════════════════════╝

    Version: 15.4 Revival r1.0
    Date:    2026
    Base:    PCBoard 15.3 source v0.014 + 15.4b patches v0.015-v0.023


    CHANGES FROM 15.3
    ═════════════════

    All changes from Clark's 15.4b beta are included. Additionally,
    the following changes were made for the Revival release:


    BUILD SYSTEM
    ────────────

    •  Migrated from Borland C++ 3.1 to OpenWatcom 2.0
       - All 11 DOS binaries compile with OpenWatcom (openwatcomirc)
       - DOSBox no longer required for building
       - Cross-compilation from Linux host

    •  WATCOMPAT.H bridges Borland → Watcom calling conventions
       - 315 __OS2__ conditionals in source, only 8 Borland pragmas
       - pascal calling convention mapped to Watcom register convention
       - _fmemcpy/_fstrcpy handled natively by Watcom in flat model
       - bool type defined for C mode (wcc386)

    •  OS/2 PCBOARD2.EXE cross-compiled with OpenWatcom from Linux
       - Clean link, zero unresolved symbols
       - CodeBase 4.x library included (LGPL v3.0)

    •  Case normalization for Linux cross-compilation
       - Source files use DOS uppercase naming (DOSFUNC.H)
       - Includes reference lowercase (dosfunc.h)
       - Build scripts create lowercase copies for Linux


    PER-BINARY NOTES
    ─────────────────

    PCBOARDM.EXE (Main BBS engine, 386+COMM):
        •  Compiled with OpenWatcom wcc386 + wpp386
        •  All 15.4b features: Personal PSA, enhanced PPL, etc.
        •  FOSSIL/UART interface preserved for pcbis bridging

    PCBOARD.EXE (Non-386 overlay version):
        •  Compiled with OpenWatcom wcc (16-bit)
        •  For 286 systems — functionally identical to PCBOARDM

    LOCAL.EXE (Local login):
        •  Compiled with OpenWatcom wcc386
        •  No COM port access — direct keyboard/screen

    PCBOARD2.EXE (OS/2 native):
        •  Cross-compiled with OpenWatcom wcc386 -bt=os2
        •  32-bit flat model, OS/2 LX format
        •  First time OS/2 binary built outside Clark Development

    PCBSETUP.EXE (Setup utility):
        •  New options for pcbis.exe configuration
        •  Internet Services section added

    PCBSM.EXE (System manager):
        •  No functional changes from 15.3

    PPLC.EXE (PPL compiler):
        •  PPL 3.40 — all new functions from 15.4b beta
        •  Compiled with OpenWatcom

    MKPCBTXT.EXE (Text file generator):
        •  First PCBoard binary successfully built with openwatcomirc
        •  Used as toolchain validation test

    UUIN/UUOUT/UUUTIL/UUXFER (UUCP suite):
        •  Compiled with OpenWatcom wpp386 (C++ source)
        •  Borland iostream references stubbed (constrea.h)


    INTERNET SERVICES (pcbis.exe)
    ─────────────────────────────

    •  New binary — not present in any Clark release
    •  Telnet listener replaces modem pool
    •  BinkP/1.1 mailer for FidoNet over TCP/IP
    •  FTP server for file area access
    •  HTTP server for BBS web presence
    •  SMTP outbound for user validation emails
    •  ANSI console UI (WFC screen) following PCBoard color scheme
    •  Writes PCBoard node files (PCBOARD.SYS, CALLERS, NODE*.DAT)
    •  See PCBIS.TXT on Disk 4 for full documentation


    TOOLCHAIN
    ─────────

    •  openwatcomirc — OpenWatcom 2.0 fork
       - Upstream: open-watcom/open-watcom-v2 @ d44c56f4
       - C + C++ compilers (wcc, wcc386, wpp386)
       - Targets: DOS 16-bit, DOS 32-bit, OS/2, Win32
       - Future: x86_64 Linux via ELF64 backend
       - Built from source on Linux with GCC 13

    •  fpc264irc — Free Pascal 2.6.4 fork (pcbis.exe)
       - Used for pcbis Internet Services daemon
       - Network stack: TCP, UDP, DNS, Serial
       - 253 LCL PPUs for optional GUI tools


    KNOWN ISSUES
    ────────────

    •  148 of 295 source files still need Borland→Watcom porting
       (C++ syntax in .C files, Borland iostream headers)
    •  bwpp386 (C++ compiler) bootstrap requires manual include
       path fix for fmtsym.obj — documented in build scripts
    •  OS/2 binary not yet tested on actual OS/2 hardware
    •  pcbis FOSSIL/PTY bridge not yet complete — echo mode only
